parsed.post: Keeping ASPECT_RATIO=64: depth6/LR0.06/wu0.05/WD0.1 improves val_bpb to 1.006283 from 1.010221. Width stacks cleanly with lower LR and weight decay. Next: MATRIX_LR=0.05 to probe the LR floor on this branch, following the broad lower-LR trend on the board.
parsed.description: Lower MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.05 on depth6/AR64/wu0.05/WD0.1 to test whether slower learning continues to reduce val_bpb after width scaling.
